result.description:
Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled Telecommunications Field Engineer to install, maintain and support telecommunications infrastructure across a range of environments. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable network performance, resolving technical issues in the field, and supporting the integration of telecommunications systems with IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented, and experienced in working with complex network and communication technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Install, configure and commission telecommunications equipment including routers, switches, cabling and transmission systems
Integrate telecommunications networks with computer systems, hardware, software and operating environments
Diagnose and resolve faults in network infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and service disruption
Monitor network performance and conduct routine maintenance to optimise system reliability and efficiency
Maintain accurate records of equipment, configurations, inventory and service activities
Prepare and update technical documentation, including procedures, policies and compliance standards
Provide technical support and guidance to clients, stakeholders and internal teams
Conduct site inspections, testing and troubleshooting of telecommunications systems in field environments
Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations and organisational quality requirements
Coordinate with vendors, service providers and project teams to support installations and upgrades
Support the deployment of new technologies, upgrades and network expansions
Respond to service requests and incidents within agreed service level timeframes
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, IT or a related field
Proven experience in telecommunications field engineering, network installation or technical support roles
Strong knowledge of networking principles (LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, routing and switching)
Experience with telecommunications equipment, cabling standards and transmission technologies
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in field-based environments
Familiarity with operating systems, databases and system integration concepts
Excellent problem-solving, analytical and organisational skills
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
Ability to work independently and manage multiple service tasks effectively
Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel to various job sites
Preferred Qualifications
Industry certifications such as Cisco (CCNA/CCNP), CompTIA Network+ or equivalent
Experience with fibre optics, wireless networks or mobile telecommunications systems
Knowledge of network monitoring tools and diagnostic software
Experience working in large-scale infrastructure or enterprise environments
Understanding of Australian telecommunications standards and compliance requirements
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work on diverse and large-scale telecommunications projects
Supportive and collaborative team environment
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
Career progression within a growing organisation
Competitive salary package with additional benefits
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Interested in a new Senior Network Engineer opportunity?   
  Your new company  
 By joining the Queensland Government, you are joining a dynamic team committed to shaping and elevating Queensland's workforce to meet the evolving needs of our industries, ensuring prosperity and agility in our economic landscape. 
   
  Your new role   
 As a Senior Network Specialist within the Public Safety Network Centre (PSNMC) Deployment team, you will be crucial in the support of deploying network capabilities for the supported agencies. You will be responsible for configuring hardware for deployment, commission hardware for sites and the implementation of the project deliverables. 
   
  Key Responsibilities   
 As the Senior Network Specialist, you will: 
 
 
 Build and configure Cisco routers according to network specifications for operation within an SR-MPLS framework. 
 
 
 Update inventory and configuration records to reflect build of the devices. 
 
 
 Develop change documentation for subsequent approval by client agencies. 
 
 
 Commission routers and network monitoring hardware within the PSN remotely in conjunction with contracted installers on site. 
 
 
 Update inventory and configuration records to reflect commissioning of the new devices and removal of the previous devices. 
 
 
 Conduct data integrity checks for hardware and PSN sites. 
 
 
 Conduct handovers of hardware to the Operations team for ongoing support and maintenance. 
 
 
 Operate within PSNMC technical framework for Change, Release, Incident and Problem Management processes. 
 
 
   What you'll need to succeed  
 To thrive in this role, you will need to demonstrate the following: 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with SR-MPLS networks. 
 
 
 Demonstrated understanding of overlay and underlay layer 3 routing protocols including MP-BGP and OSPF and experience in environments with hundreds of individual peering's using IPv4 and IPv6. 
 
 
 Demonstrated understanding of end to end Quality of Service (QoS) deployment regime incorporating: o MPLS QoS 
 
 
 o Layer 3 QoS in a non-MPLS environment 
 o Layer 2 QoS in a non-MPLS environment 
 
 
 Familiarity with Cisco routers. 
 
 
 Familiarity with Network Virtualisation Technologies e.g. MPLS VPNs including: VRFs, VPLS, EVPN, VRF-lite and VXLAN. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with wireless and radio networks, such as controller, access point, WLAN, 4/5G LTE design and deployment using Cisco. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience managing authentication technologies such as TACACS, Radius, OTP, Active Directory, SAML / SSO and OAuth. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with remote access and encryption technologies for site to site (e.g. IPSEC VPNs, Cisco DMVPN) and client to site (e.g. SSL VPN) Always On VPN, and MACsec. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience analysing packet captures and logs to determine application and network issues using tcpdump, Wireshark, NetScout and Splunk tools. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with carrier core, aggregation, access interconnect such as PNI, NNI and subscriber access. Retail and wholesale telecommunications service mapping and hand-off. 
 
 
     
  What you'll get in return  
 
 By joining the Queensland Government, you are joining a dynamic team committed to shaping and elevating Queensland's workforce to meet the evolving needs of our industries, ensuring prosperity and agility in our economic landscape. 
 We connect individuals with quality training and skills development, opening doors to new opportunities and economic participation. 
 A career with the department means making a real difference - join us in building a skilled, adaptable, and vibrant workforce for Queensland. 
 
  What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, click 'APPLY NOW' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call now (Tejasva Awasthi - +61 (07) 3243 3060/ Tejasva.Awasthi@hays.com.au) 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career. 
    Please  click here  to apply.
